services.name: Peak City Kids - Day Camp
services.desc: Looking for a fun, safe, and faith-based summer camp in Colorado Springs? Peak City Day Camp is the perfect option for local families searching for an unforgettable summer experience for their kids. We’re partnering with Eagle Lake to host an incredible five-day day camp in Colorado Springs designed for kids ages 6-12. Each day is packed with high-energy games, creative activities, team building, and meaningful moments centered on Jesus. Peak City Day Camp gives Colorado Springs families the best parts of summer camp without overnight stays.
